data.body: **[P2] Preserve inline-envelope support in the three-argument overload.** This public overload installs a resolver with a null execution ARN. A valid v1 inline envelope can be produced without any external offloader—for example when a custom `SerDes` returns the reserved marker—so `getResult()` or `getStepResult()` now throws “Execution ARN is required” instead of returning the original value. Resolve inline envelopes using their embedded producer context, while still failing references that require an unavailable offloader, and add a reserved-marker round-trip test through this overload.
